selection: Ordinary longer temporary tie candidate for the tripod-manual upper-mast preparation state. Not identified as the kit's supplied tie.

sources.facts: Black UV-resistant PA66W, nonreleasable plastic pawl, inside serration, 100 pieces per bag. Length 390 mm, strap width 4.6 mm, thickness 1.4 mm, head length 7.2 mm, head width 8.1 mm, bundle diameter 1.5 to 110 mm. Listed unit mass 2.418 g and minimum tensile strength 225 N do not qualify the simulated assembly.
Article-specific sheet confirms 390 x 4.6 x 1.4 mm, 110 mm maximum bundle and black PA66W. Inspected diagram shows the serrated strap and tapered insertion end.

Family drawing: length 390 +/-10 mm, strap 4.6 +/-0.2 mm, thickness 1.2 +/-0.2 mm, head height 5.8 +/-0.3 mm, width 8.0 +/-0.5 mm, length 7.0 +/-0.5 mm; 110 mm maximum bundle. Bent free tail is shown.
Family table includes T50L-W and records the earlier thickness/length revisions. Its nominal dimensions match the CSH drawing.

Older informational family drawing: length 380 +/-15 mm, width 4.7 +/-0.2 mm, thickness 1.4 +/-0.2 mm, head length 7.6 +/-0.9 mm and width 8.3 +/-0.7 mm. These differing nominals are retained rather than silently merged.

selection_basis: Article-specific nominal dimensions take precedence. The 5.8 mm head height comes from the family drawings. Selected values fit the shown family tolerances; this does not resolve factory revision differences.
inferences: Local feed opening, integral pawl, groove profile, molded taper and small radii remain authored family-topology hypotheses.
The separate stock inspection mesh is flattened. Installed temporary ties retain their full stock length and protruding tapered tail; no tensioning, cutting or flexibility execution is credited.
rights: Independently authored geometry. Manufacturer drawings and product pages are referenced without redistribution.
